achievements.name: First Step into Darkness
achievements.description: Complete the game on Casual difficulty.

achievements.name: Another Day on the Job
achievements.description: Complete the game on Survival difficulty.

achievements.name: Master of Horror
achievements.description: Complete the game on Nightmare difficulty.

achievements.name: Every Nook and Cranny
achievements.description: Collect every collectable in the game.

achievements.name: Master of Unlocking
achievements.description: Open up all the lockers in the save room.

achievements.name: Hardbody
achievements.description: Fully upgrade all of Sebastian's attributes.

achievements.name: My Best Friend
achievements.description: Completely upgrade one weapon.

achievements.name: The Power of Three
achievements.description: Completely upgrade three weapons.

achievements.name: Unstoppable Arsenal
achievements.description: Completely upgrade all weapons.

achievements.name: Why Can't I Hold All This Ammo?
achievements.description: Upgrade all options in the Stock menu.

achievements.name: Blow Up the Playing Field
achievements.description: Use a secret explosive weapon to kill 10 enemies. (Agony Bolt effects negate results)

achievements.name: Full House
achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with each type of Agony Bolt.

achievements.name: Silent Kill
achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies in a row with a sneak kill without being discovered.

achievements.name: Burn, Baby, Burn!
achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with a torch.

achievements.name: ...And the Corpses Mount
achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies.

achievements.name: Krimson PD Fury
achievements.description: Kill 200 enemies.

achievements.name: One Man Army
achievements.description: Kill 400 enemies.

achievements.name: Ammo Conservationist
achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies with melee attacks.

achievements.name: Bloody Bar Brawl
achievements.description: Sneak Kill an enemy after hitting them with a bottle.

achievements.name: Drop It Like It's Hot
achievements.description: Kill 3 living enemies with one drop of a match.

achievements.name: The Quick and the Dead
achievements.description: Finish the game with a clear time of under 5:00:00

achievements.name: It Is What It Is
achievements.description: Finish the game without upgrading any skills with green gel.

achievements.name: You Asked For It
achievements.description: Finish the game on 悪夢(AKUMU) mode.

achievements.name: À la Corvo
achievements.description: Have they lost their minds? Better get past them without a fight.  (Ch.2)

achievements.name: Knife Beats Chainsaw
achievements.description: His engine roars, but my knife is strong enough to take him out. (Ch.3)

achievements.name: Home is Where the Hospice is
achievements.description: That vision in the hospice... why here? Why now? (Ch. 4)

achievements.name: Not Part of the Job Description
achievements.description: The water's rising, but we'll get out of this without a scratch. (Ch. 5)

achievements.name: Everybody Gets One
achievements.description: Who wouldn't reach out for a man clinging for his life? (Ch. 6)

achievements.name: I Don't Have Time for This!
achievements.description: It won't stay dead! Better only fight when I have to. (Ch. 7)

achievements.name: Item Management
achievements.description: This cave echoes like crazy. Better put the gun away and keep quiet. (Ch. 8)

achievements.name: Bathed in Flames
achievements.description: Enough running! I'll burn her to the ground right here! (Ch. 10)

achievements.name: Not a Scratch on Her!
achievements.description: I'm not taking any chances, this bus can't take much more damage. (Ch. 12)

achievements.name: Entry Level Electrician
achievements.description: I should get this whole generator panel running just in case. (Ch. 14)

achievements.name: Prank Call
achievements.description: Lure an enemy with a phone call and lock them in a room. (Ch. 1)

achievements.name: Clutch!
achievements.description: Use a single trap to kill two or more enemies in The Assignment. (Ch. 2)

achievements.name: All You Need is Axe
achievements.description: Survive the duel without using any electronic devices in the environment. (Ch. 2)

achievements.name: Death Grip
achievements.description: Get a Cadaver to grab and kill a Haunted. (Ch. 2)

achievements.name: Doctor's Notes
achievements.description: Collect all Research Documents in The Assignment.

achievements.name: A Piece of My Past
achievements.description: Collect all Personnel Files in The Assignment.

achievements.name: A Warning
achievements.description: Complete the hidden letter in The Assignment.

achievements.name: Not Afraid of the Dark
achievements.description: Clear The Assignment in KURAYAMI Mode.

achievements.name: A Real Hero
achievements.description: Save Sebastian's life in the hotel. (Ch. 4)

achievements.name: There Will Not Be Blood
achievements.description: Get through the hotel without being spotted or killing any enemies. (Ch. 4)

achievements.name: Stick to the Script
achievements.description: Defeat Ruvik before the final showdown in The Consequence. (Ch. 4)

achievements.name: Where Do We Go From Here?
It's All Your Fault
achievements.description: Collect all Research Documents in The Consequence.

achievements.name: Becoming an Agent
achievements.description: Collect all Personnel Files in The Consequence.

achievements.name: This is Just the Beginning
achievements.description: Complete the hidden letter in The Consequence.

achievements.name: None More Dark
achievements.description: Clear The Consequence in KURAYAMI Mode.
